FX-WIRE-001.says: The settings as added: displace, from 25, 50 to 75, 50, thickness 5, slope 50, mirror blend 25. The remover reaches 5 pixels each side of the line between columns 4 and 12, so the whole height there is smoothed, most at the middle.

FX-WIRE-002.says: Fade along the wire, thickness 3: the wire and a soft edge each side made clear, the ramp showing through the edges; past the ends untouched.

FX-WIRE-003.says: Frame offset 1 along the wire: frames 0 and 2 take the band from the clean, redder plate after them, so the wire is gone; frame 3 would read frame 4, where the layer does not show, so it is untouched.

FX-WIRE-004.says: Frame offset -1: frame 0 would read frame -1, so it is untouched; frame 2 reads frame 1, the clean plate.

FX-WIRE-005.says: Frame offset 1.7, taken down to 1: the same as FX-WIRE-003.

FX-WIRE-006.says: Displace along the wire, thickness 3: the wire replaced by the ramp above and below it, mixed across the band, a quarter mirrored.

FX-WIRE-007.says: Mirror blend 0: the band is only the mix of the two edges.

FX-WIRE-008.says: Mirror blend 100: the band is only the picture reflected in its edges.

FX-WIRE-009.says: Slope 0: the edge fades over a whole thickness each side.

FX-WIRE-010.says: Slope 100, thickness 4: a hard edge, every pixel within 2 of the line replaced whole and none past it touched.

FX-WIRE-012.says: Both points at 50, 54: the drawing, untouched.

FX-WIRE-013.says: Displace horizontal along the flat wire: no row crosses it, so the drawing is untouched.

FX-WIRE-014.says: Displace on a wire straight down the middle, from 50, 0 to 50, 100.

FX-WIRE-015.says: Displace horizontal on the same upright wire: across it is along a row, so the same as FX-WIRE-014.

FX-WIRE-016.says: Displace horizontal on a slanting wire from 20, 10 to 80, 90: each sample taken along its own row.

FX-WIRE-017.says: Displace on the same slanting wire: the samples taken across the wire, so not the same as FX-WIRE-016.

FX-WIRE-018.says: Thickness keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 2, linear: 2, 4 and 6.

FX-WIRE-019.says: FX-WIRE-006 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-WIRE-020.says: A wire along the top edge, from 10, 4 to 90, 4, thickness 4: the samples above the picture are held to its top row.

FX-WIRE-021.says: Frame offset on an adjustment layer above the holder: the frames beneath at other times are not to hand, so each frame as it is, with a warning each frame.

FX-WIRE-022.says: Displace on an adjustment layer above the holder: the frame beneath is the holder alone, so the same as FX-WIRE-006.

FX-WIRE-023.says: Removal style "clone", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-024.says: Removal style "Displace": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-025.says: Thickness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-026.says: Slope -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-027.says: Mirror blend 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-028.says: Frame offset 1001, past 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-029.says: Point A at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIRE-030.says: Thickness keyed to 150 at frame 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
